title: The Eyes of Glouphrie
start: Brimstail in a cave in the south-west side of the Gnome Stronghold, directly west of the bank.

items.t: 1 ground mud rune (made by clicking on a mud rune in your inventory)
A bucket of sap (obtained by using an empty bucket on an evergreen or acadia tree with a knife on your tool belt)

recommended.t: A long-range weapon (Chargebow, staff of air, halberd, etc.) to kill an evil creature that tends to get stuck behind some obstacles, unreachable by melee.
Access to the fairy ring transportation system or Yanille lodestone activated
Quick access to a Spirit Tree (i.e. Ring of duelling to South Feldip Hills Teleport or Teleport to Varrock by the Grand Exchange)

rewards.t: Small crystal seed; you can take it either to Ilfeen in Isafdar or the singing bowl in Brimstail's cave to turn it into a crystal saw. It allows you to make items that require a saw and 3 levels above your Construction level. It has only 28 charges; however, the recharge is free.
Ability to use any of the singing bowls, including the one in Prifddinas, useful for creating the Attuned crystal teleport seed.

steps.t: Talk to Brimstail in a cave west of the bank in the Gnome Stronghold (Maplink | text=View map | mtype=square | x=2406 | y=3420 | r=5 ). Look for dungeon link on minimap [Chat: 1 What's that cute creature wandering around? › 1 Yes, that sounds fascinating... › 1 Oh, yes I love a bit of History. › Accept]
p: Glouphrie (bottom centre), King Healthorg (top centre), Hazelmere (right), and Oaknock, facing the goblins

steps.t: Inspect the singing bowl in the western portion of the cave.
To the north, attempt to unlock Oaknock's machine and use Oaknock's exchanger.
Talk to Brimstail. [Chat: 1 I've had a look in the other room now. › 1 Of course, I'd love to!]
Talk to Hazelmere (island east of Yanille, fairy ring CLS) for several cutscenes. He provides you with a violet pentagon.
Return and talk to Brimstail. [Chat: 1 I've visited Hazelmere, he told me all sorts of interesting things.]
Grind mud rune and use on bucket of sap.
Use the magic glue and a set of maple and oak logs on Oaknock's exchanger and repair it.
Talk to Brimstail. [Chat: 1 I think I've fixed the machine now!]

Talk to him again three or more times to receive more discs [Chat: 1 I can't work out what to do with these discs!]. You will need to drop all of your discs and pick them back up after chatting to receive more discs. The more discs, the more streamlined the process in the next step becomes as you require little to no converting.
p: Disc exchanger (An input of 32 gives an output of 32)

steps.t: Unlock machine to view the desired number.

If necessary, use the exchanger to get a disc equal to your number (refer to conversion chart below, insert not more than 35 points at a time). If you have trouble converting, refer to the full guide here.
Unlock the machine with the correct value disc. Click the small green square to submit the disc.

Unlock the machine again to get 3 different numbers (the second unlock will require many more discs). Use the exchanger as necessary. The second number requires using 2 discs and the third requires 3 discs.
Talk to Brimstail. [Chat: 1 Phew! I've got that machine working now. What do I need to do now?]
Kill the evil creature by Brimstail and talk to him again. (1/6).

Kill the 5 remaining evil creatures, which can be done in any order (Maplink | x=2446 | y=3457 | x:2406,y:3420,title:1/6,desc:Brimstail's cave,icon:redPin | x:2460,y:3389,title:2/6,desc:By the main gate | x:2461,y:3445,title:3/6,desc:South of the spirit tree | x:2420,y:3526,title:4/6,desc:Giant tortoise pen | x:2465,y:3496,title:5/6,desc:Top floor; by the ladder | x:2467,y:3496,title:6/6,desc:Ground floor; by King Narnode | mtype=pin | text=View map ):

sub.t: (2/6) By the main gate to the stronghold (south-east from Brimstail's cave)
(3/6) South of the spirit tree by the gnome agility course entrance.
(4/6) In the giant tortoise pen north-west of the Grand Tree and north of the swamp.

(5/6) Top floor of the Grand Tree, next to the small prison/by the ladder (wait for the chat response saying you killed it before using the ladder. If it doesn't count it, an evil creature should respawn at one of the locations.)

(6/6) Near King Narnode (may need ranged, magic or necromancy as it can get stuck behind a trapdoor). Check your quest journal if your chat log does not display 6 creatures, if it says you need to talk to the king then you are finished.

p: Glouphrie creates an army of illusory giant tortoises.
The invisible gnome that destroys the machine.

steps.t: Talk to King Narnode Shareen on the floor 1 of the Grand Tree.
